group.title: Correcting an expense claim
group.passage:
Woman: My travel reimbursement was returned because the taxi receipt doesn't show the payment date.
Man: Do you still have the booking confirmation?
Woman: Yes, but it only shows the booking time.
Man: Check the taxi app. You can usually download an itemized receipt after the trip.
Woman: I found it. It has the date, fare, and company registration number.
Man: Great. Attach that file to your existing claim. Do not start another one. I will review it this afternoon.
group.passageZh:
女：我的差旅費申請被退回，因為計程車收據沒有顯示付款日期。
男：你還留著預訂確認信嗎？
女：有，但那只顯示預約時間。
男：看看計程車應用程式。行程結束後通常可以下載明細收據。
女：我找到了。上面有日期、車資和公司登記號碼。
男：很好。把那個檔案附在你原本的申請上。不要另開新申請。我今天下午會審查。
